targets.title: Looking forward, looking back: Anticipation is more evocative than retrospection.

targets.outcome_quote:
In our replication, we found that all results for menstruation were consistent with the

original results. For Thanksgiving Day and vacation scenarios, only the findings for intensity of

emotion and the regression of influence on current mood and intensity of emotions were

consistent with the original results while the others are inconsistent.
